{{Top|leg}}
A '''line slinger''' was a weapon that could fire a line of cable up to twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The line could be affixed to [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling]] or [[magnetic hook]]s. [[Noval Garaint]] had an internal line slinger as part of his [[Model 210 personal armor]].
